claims.title: Unknown-direction content resolves through HTML dir=auto semantics
claims.nonClaim: This verifies the controlled fixture and browser behavior; it does not prove every consuming application applies direction metadata correctly.

claims.title: Controlled dir=auto traversal ignores isolated or explicitly directed descendants and skips weak or neutral prefixes
claims.nonClaim: These independently authored vectors cover selected HTML direction-estimation semantics and are not a copy of, or substitute for, the complete W3C Internationalization test suite.

claims.title: Form submission preserves textarea direction through dirname
claims.nonClaim: The toolkit does not infer server trust or sanitize arbitrary form values.

claims.title: Controlled conformance controls meet the 24 by 24 CSS pixel target-size floor
claims.nonClaim: This is regression evidence for the fixture, not a WCAG conformance certification for downstream products.

claims.title: Controlled conformance fixture reflows at a 320 CSS pixel viewport without horizontal page overflow
claims.nonClaim: This is a targeted reflow invariant and does not establish complete WCAG 1.4.10 conformance for arbitrary content or applications.

claims.title: Controlled focused component remains visible below author-created sticky content
claims.nonClaim: This verifies one deterministic sticky-content case using scroll padding; it is not a complete WCAG 2.4.11 evaluation of arbitrary overlays or downstream interfaces.

claims.title: Controlled Arabic and mixed-direction content tolerates WCAG text-spacing overrides without clipping or loss of the adjacent control
claims.nonClaim: This is a controlled regression case and does not establish WCAG 1.4.12 conformance for every typography system, language, script, component, or consuming application.

claims.title: Controlled focus indicator remains explicit in a forced-colors environment
claims.nonClaim: This verifies one controlled focus-ring implementation under emulated forced colors; it is not a complete contrast audit of downstream interfaces or operating-system themes.

claims.title: Toolkit motion-respect utility collapses authored animation and transition durations when reduced motion is requested
claims.nonClaim: This verifies the toolkit utility and controlled fixture; it does not establish that every consuming product removes all non-essential motion.
